mechanism_narrative: Persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE rises by >0.3pp, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad-based consumer demand weakness, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or interaction term Rank IC is below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In a manufacturing slowdown regime (INDPRO below 95), declining industrial production compresses corporate earnings growth expectations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 95, or Rank IC for regime condition is below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly year-over-year CPIAUCSL increase exceeding 2.5% signals rising inflation expectations that prompt central bank tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY growth exceeds 2.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and GDP (GDPC1) indicate a broad-based supply-side contraction, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both INDPRO and GDPC1 decline, or interaction term Rank IC is below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing market downturn (HOUST below 700,000 units), reduced consumer spending and wealth effects depress equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST < 700, or Rank IC for regime condition is below 0.02 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A persistently low industrial production index (INDPRO below 98) reflects weak manufacturing activity, compressing corporate profit margins and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in less than 45% of periods when INDPRO < 98, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
